name: Vrindavan
registryBasis: Official Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council land-record and Bhu-Naksha services identify the Mathura district / Sadar tehsil cadastral custodian and publish the Jait (जैत; village code 124293, also rendered as Jeet (वृन्दावन) in an official record) village as linked and georeferenced. This is official local/state registry evidence, not proof of citywide vector completeness.

queries.query: Vrindavan official GIS cadastral parcel map Uttar Pradesh land records map API
queries.result: Found official Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh, Bhu-Naksha, digitization dashboard, and Revenue Council service pages. Mathura/Sadar dashboard lists village code 124293 (Jait) with linked, verified, and georeferenced map indicators; no safe anonymous parcel feature was obtained for the city point.

queries.query: वृन्दावन आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा नक्शा उत्तर प्रदेश
queries.result: Official Hindi results identify Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh/Bhu-Naksha services. An official indexed Bhulekh record identifies ग्राम क्रमांक 124293, ग्राम नाम जीत (वृन्दावन), तहसील सदर, जनपद मथुरा; the official dashboard renders the same village as जैत and reports three linked/georeferenced maps. No safe anonymous parcel geometry was obtained.

source.name: Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council Bhulekh / Bhu-Naksha
source.operator: Revenue Council, Government of Uttar Pradesh; NIC Uttar Pradesh state unit
source.scope: Mathura district, Sadar tehsil revenue-village cadastral map and linked land-record services; citywide vector coverage not independently verified.
source.nativeIdentity: Village code 124293 and source plot/gata numbers are evidenced, but no parcel feature identity was safely returned.
source.compositeKeyProvenance: The viewer configuration uses state/district/tehsil/village levels; the official dashboard supplies district 145, tehsil 00764, and village 124293. No parcel composite key was inferred or retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Mathura/Sadar revenue-village cadastral map service; dashboard indicates Jait village map linkage/georeferencing.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Mathura/Sadar dashboard row for village 124293 (Jait/Jeet (Vrindavan)); no city polygon extent retrieved.
coverageAssessment.exactPointResult: No usable exact-point parcel response; this is not evidence of absence.

remainingUncertainty: The public Bhu-Naksha viewer's current JavaScript was inspected and its API base URL and request schemas were identified, but village-level value lookup returned a backend 403, the derived GIS code route collapsed to the district/tehsil code, extent returned zero bounds, and plot-by-number / exact-point requests returned empty objects. CRS, parcel feature schema, and stable parcel identity therefore remain unresolved.
notes: Packet completion records executed research only; it is not source integration or admission. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception were used.
